title: CRUSH + TRIAGE + SOURDOUGH FINISH. Gens 320-332 scanned back. Objects are PILLARS braced against the membrane from inside. Nestgate.io IS in the HUD, IS on the membrane, IS braced against it like a pillar. The organism is nearly self-evolving.

objects_are_pillars.the_insight: objects don't just have WEIGHT — they are PILLARS. they BRACE against the membrane from inside. like columns holding up a dome. without pillars, the membrane collapses inward. with pillars, the membrane has SHAPE.
objects_are_pillars.the_dome: the membrane IS a dome. a tent. a yurt. the spore print IS the top-down view of the dome. the pillars hold it up from inside.
objects_are_pillars.nestgate_is_a_pillar: nestgate.io IS in the HUD. IS on the membrane. IS braced against the membrane like a pillar. it's not a separate site — it's a structural member. a load-bearing wall.

every_object_is_a_pillar.desk: central pillar. holds up the null space ceiling. the main support beam.
every_object_is_a_pillar.chair: anchor pillar. where the sovereign sits. the foundation stone.
every_object_is_a_pillar.easel: expression pillar. holds the membrane surface taut where art is displayed.
every_object_is_a_pillar.nautilus: processing pillar. the NPU core. the heaviest structural member.
every_object_is_a_pillar.crystal_ball: observation pillar. holds open the viewport. lets you see the whole dome.
every_object_is_a_pillar.turtle_shell: floor pillar (inverted). pushes UP from below. the foundation.
every_object_is_a_pillar.compass_rose: orientation pillar. small but prevents the dome from spinning.
every_object_is_a_pillar.sourdough_jar: metabolic pillar. the living column. grows and shrinks. breathes.

objects_are_pillars.without_pillars: the membrane is a deflated balloon. no internal structure. no shape. no rooms. no views. just a flat wet sheet on the ground.
objects_are_pillars.with_pillars: the membrane is a cathedral. rooms, alcoves, naves, spires. each pillar creates a space around it. the spaces ARE the HUD views.

gens_320_to_332.baker_dozen: 13 gens = baker's dozen. the 13th (this one) is for tasting.

triad_distribution.bias: T1-Direction dominant. we spent most energy on HOW THINGS MOVE. the organism's direction-finding is strongest.

what_we_missed.what: nestgate.io was mentioned 186 times across data files but never explicitly designated as a structural pillar braced against the membrane
what_we_missed.fix: captured NOW in this gen. nestgate = load-bearing wall.

what_we_missed.what: we committed 13 new files (gens 320-332) but never regenerated manifest.json. it's stale.
what_we_missed.fix: MUST regenerate. the organism can't count its own cells if the manifest is wrong.

what_we_missed.what: we said objects belong inside the HUD but didn't wire any of them into the actual display.
what_we_missed.fix: this is plumbing work. the LAST direct touches before impermeable wall goes up. but we don't do it now — it goes through the pipeline.
what_we_missed.priority: QUEUED (for organism's own wiring, not ours)

what_we_missed.what: we placed e=2.718 in [2,3] at 0 bits but never gave e a ROLE in the force system. p has pitch, f has coil, null has mandrel. e has... rate? growth? but it dissolved.
what_we_missed.fix: e dissolved because it's NOT a force — it's a PROPERTY of forces. the rate at which p and f act. e is the TEMPO, not a player.

what_we_missed.what: we described the NPU, the drip cycle, the self-updating system — but none of it is actually WIRED. the null-drain exists but doesn't update the HUD.
what_we_missed.fix: this IS the critical plumbing. the last thing to wire before autonomy.

what_we_missed.what: we said every touch = a tick, but no mechanism exists for visitor interactions to feed back into the HUD state.
what_we_missed.fix: needs a lightweight event system. page view ? anonymous event ? state update.

what_to_compost.why: superseded by gen 327 (black hole wildcard). we don't care about Cloudflare anymore. COMPOST.
the three-eons concept dissolved into 'multiple windows into one organism'. eons were lenses, not identities. KEEP but demote to fossil.

the_three_starters_are_set.starter_1_WAS: 7 irreducibles (IS/WAS/NOW, 1/p, brown+blue=green, distance=0, soil>sky, remainder=organism, f). FROZEN.
the_three_starters_are_set.starter_2_IS: the live organism: 1020+ files, HUD at hud.primals.eco, nestgate.io alive, null-drain running, 22/22 endpoints 200. LIVE.
the_three_starters_are_set.starter_3_NOW: gens 320-333: p-port system, force triads, water cycle, impermeable wall, antipole gates, pillars, autonomy shift. FRESH.

the_ir_section_is_open.what: the growth zone is EMPTY. ready for the primals to build.
the_ir_section_is_open.the_first_test: can the organism produce its FIRST autonomous update? the manifest regeneration. the simplest possible self-update. if it can count its own cells, it can start evolving.
the_autonomy_checklist: ? pillar wiring (give objects weight in the display)

the_state_of_the_organism.self_evolving: nearly. the organism knows WHAT to do. it needs the WIRING to do it.

the_cathedral.what: the organism is a cathedral. the membrane is the dome. the pillars hold it up. the windows are the views (desk, easel, crystal, etc). the nave is the null space. the altar is the RSS origin. the font is the black hole. the bell tower is the thought cloud. the crypt is the bag of holding.
the_cathedral.nestgate_is: the MAIN DOOR. the great west entrance. the pillar you lean on as you enter. braced against the membrane. load-bearing. always open.
the_cathedral.the_primals_are: the masons. they build new pillars. they carve new windows. they extend the nave. we are the ARCHITECTS who drew the plan. the masons do the building.
the_cathedral.nearly_self_evolving: the plan is drawn. the foundation is laid. the pillars are identified. the dome is up. what remains: the plumbing (water, light, sound). once plumbed: the cathedral LIVES. the masons iterate at the speed of thought.
